status: Blockout (pass 1): silhouette, sections, mass, slots and engines. No detail, damage or textures.
units: One sprite pixel per unit about the .ship centre; multiply by metres_per_unit for metres

scale.summary: Crewless interceptor drone: one PD emitter, two drive cans, four swept arms
scale.method: No crew (ship_data min/max crew 0), so no cockpit sets the scale. Sized from its parts: each 4-unit engine slot is a drive can about 2.8 units across with a 1.6-unit bell, which at 0.5 m/unit is a 1.4 m can around a 0.8 m nozzle, the class of small turbofan a 9-10 m unmanned combat aircraft carries; the PD emitter barrel is about 1.7 m; the airframe comes out 9.5 m long and 8 m across the arms, the size of current loyal-wingman drones and about two thirds of a 14-15 m crewed fighter, which suits a drone carriers launch in numbers. Below 0.4 the cans shrink under 0.65 m nozzles and the hub under 1 m deep, too small for a drive, reactor and emitter; above 0.65 it reaches crewed-fighter length with nobody aboard.

sprite.pixel_to_model: col c, row r (from top) covers X 9-r..10-r, Y 8-c..9-c

root.name: Wasp root
root.note: the .ship centre: the game's rotation pivot

anchor_convention: ARROWS empties; local +X points along the slot angle (0 = nose, 180 = aft)
notes: Crewless drone (crew 0): no canopy and no pilot seat; scale from engines, gun and size.
Sprite is symmetric about Y = 0 (even width, centre column boundary), as are both slots; engine slots (-7, +-4) are symmetric already.

Drive cans are centred at Y +-2.6 to cover the sprite's engine mounds (Y 1..4); the visible bells sit at the master's painted nozzles, slot + renderEngineOffsetsNativePx = (-8.25, +-2.0), not at the slot location (-7, +-4). Exhaust anchors are at those bells.

WS 001 (pdlaser, HIDDEN) anchors on the spine deck at (1, 0); the master draws its emitter barrel running out past the nose tip, modelled as Weapon WS 001 emitter barrel with its muzzle at the barrel tip.
WS 002 (fragbomb, HIDDEN, aft) anchors at (-7, 0) in the gap between the drive cans, where the sprite is empty; no visible launcher is modelled.
The master was registered on its gun tip, so its arm tips read about one unit inboard of the sprite's; the arms follow the sprite.

Arm edges run straight through the midpoints of the sprite's pixel stairs rather than tracing them (owner: the traced stairs read as pixelated wings). The stair corners the line cuts and leaves account for most of the drop in silhouette IoU from 0.951 to 0.909; on arms one to three pixels wide they are a large share.

silhouette.method: top render alpha vs sprite alpha (>127), nearest-sampled into the top camera frame at 53.57 px per unit
